programs.title: Michael Jackson: Searching For Neverland
programs.desc: Searching for Neverland will reveal firsthand the devotion Michael Jackson had to his children, and the hidden drama that took place during the last two years of his life. (Chad L. Coleman, Sam Adegoke, Nondumiso Tembe).

programs.title: Snackmasters
programs.sub_title: Four'N Twenty Classic Meat Pie & King Sized Sausage Roll
programs.desc: In the Grand Final, can our chefs recreate this mighty meaty meal – or will the tantalising recipe remain a pie in the sky?

programs.title: Ancestry Road
programs.desc: When Kevin's daughter continually goes missing up the back of their Scottish Farm, he builds a road. Yet when deceased family members begin arriving in their cars for a visit, everything changes. (Seb Muirhead, Jessica Stanley).

programs.title: The Pink Panther 2
programs.desc: Insp. Jacques Clouseau teams up with a squad of international detectives just as bumbling as he is. Their mission: Stop a globe-trotting thief who specialises in stealing historical artifacts.

programs.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
programs.desc: Shazam and his superpowered foster siblings band together to face the Daughters of Atlas, who have stolen the Wizard's staff and plan to use it for their own ends. (Zachary Levi, Asher Angel, Rachel Zegler, Helen Mirren).

programs.title: Who's Watching
programs.desc: In a quiet coastal town, Annabelle Pyke becomes the target of a dangerous obsessive who watches her from the shadows, turning her life into a growing nightmare. (Elle Corrigan, Jira Seow, Debora Tamay).

programs.title: Prodigal Son
programs.desc: Malcolm Bright, a former FBI profiler, is the son of a serial killer and suspects that he himself might become a sociopath. He solves crimes for the NYPD as a form of absolution for his upbringing.

programs.title: Prodigal Son
programs.desc: Malcolm has an accident and his mind sends him in another world, where his family is happy and he is in a good relationship. While his mind is going on a journey, his subconscious tells him, that something isn't right.

programs.title: The Moon Is Upside Down
programs.desc: Three women - a duped mail-order bride, a numbed anaesthetist, and an empty nester - each navigates her way through an unfamiliar landscape and the contours of the human heart.

programs.title: My Way
programs.desc: Every artist works from experience and Jet James, Jeska Vaulk and Colin Chandler have all taken on some of the toughest personal battles and found a way to channel that experience into their art, creating some light out of darkness.

programs.title: Barney's World
programs.desc: Mel makes a big mess in the park and learns it's important to care for shared spaces. / After a disagreement among the kids about what to do with a ripe tomato, Vivie learns the importance of sharing.

programs.title: I Love VIP Pets
programs.desc: What a thrill! All the VIP Pets are going to spend the day together at a festival. What could be better than a fun day with friends? Oh no... the problem is...they cannot agree on what they want to do there!
